structure: a tall vertical cutaway building shaped like a giant upright sketchbook with a spiral binding down one side, standing in the centre of a portrait canvas, a giant pencil leaning against it.
character: young graphic design intern (a woman in her early 20s, short auburn bob, round glasses, mustard cardigan)
scenes: she reads a printed design brief with a coffee at a desk, a pinboard of abstract images beside her.
she sketches small thumbnail layouts with pencils in a sketchbook at a tilted drafting table.
she works at a large monitor with a drawing tablet and stylus, a colourful abstract layout on screen, colour swatches beside her.
she presents printed layouts pinned on a wall to a senior designer, who points at one of them.
she drags files into neat colour-coded folders on screen beside a stack of finished posters; dusk through the window.
props: a giant paintbrush, a colour palette, a ruler, a pen-tool bezier curve with square nodes, a giant eraser, a fan of colour swatches, paper planes
